about_the_game:
Warspace 2 is a 1-4 player CO-OP space shooter with RPG elements, open-world and procedurally-generated galaxy. You can trade, craft, and fight your way through a universe, either solo or with friends.

1-4 PLAYER CO-OP

Join forces with up to three friends to explore and battle through a vast universe teeming with challenges. You can also play in a single-player offline mode, network connection is not required to play.

HIGH-TECH EQUIPMENT AND SHIPS

Equip your spaceship with the latest technology. From laser cannons to shield generators, ensure you have the best gear to face the dangers of space and conquer your enemies.

EPIC SPACE BATTLES

Engage in intense space battles against a variety of enemies, from space pirates to alien armadas. Use tactical maneuvers, advanced weaponry, and cooperative strategies to outsmart and overpower your adversaries.

TRADING - CRAFTING - LOOTING

Engage in a dynamic trading system with different alien civilizations. Craft powerful weapons, advanced technology, and essential supplies. Collect a variety of loot to upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, and tailor your playstyle to suit your interstellar adventures.

SANDBOX UNIVERSE EXPLORATION

Explore procedurally generated galaxy with endless possibilities. Discover new planets, meet alien species, and uncover hidden secrets. Every playthrough is different, offering a fresh open-world adventure full of challenges and surprises.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GPU GeForce GTX 750 / AMD GPU Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is is still in development, minimum system requirements may change.
